[Unit]
Description=Daily public market data update
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=oneshot
WorkingDirectory=/home/yoonhc/projects/algoTrade/historical_data
ExecStart=/home/yoonhc/projects/algoTrade/historical_data/.venv/bin/marketdata --root . update --config configs/daily.toml --report state/daily-latest.json
TimeoutStartSec=30min
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=60s

[Unit]
Description=Update archive data daily

[Timer]
# Collect after activation as well as on the daily schedule.
OnActiveSec=30s
OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:20:00 UTC
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=300

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
